title: Text-to-Speech (TTS) — From Tacotron to F5 and Kokoro
service: TTSFront: text normalization, lexicon-backed G2P, duration-to-frame allocation, LLM-to-TTS chunking and SSML flattening

parts.lesson_anchor: Pitfalls: no text normalizer, OOV proper nouns; code/main.py phonemize (greedy longest match)
planted_bugs: number_words joins tens and ones with a hyphen ('forty-two'); the ValueError surfaces three calls later in rule_phones
phonemize looks words up case-sensitively, so the lexicon entry 'Kokoro' is missed
the tokenizer splits the period off 'Dr.', so it becomes a pause and the doctor/drive lookahead sees '.'
rule_phones tries every length from the rest of the word down, O(L^2) slices per word
parts.timing_assert: a 3000-letter 'hahaha...' token under 0.05 s (unbounded match length takes about 1.1 s)
parts.overfix_guard: words missing from the lexicon are read with the grapheme rules, longest match first: dropping OOV words, skipping long words, skipping unruled characters, or a match length below MAX_RULE (single letters, the lesson's (3, 2, 1), shortest first) fails on 'Ghumare station' or the 'ha' run
clarifying_questions: abbreviation at the end of a sentence
Kokoro and kokoro both in the lexicon

parts.lesson_anchor: Step 1 phonemize (IPA output); Pitfalls: OOV proper nouns need a lexicon and a fallback
parts.exactness: IPA segments with combining tildes and tie bars, and a precomposed ç, round-trip code point for code point, across close and reopen
traps: segments joined and split per code point
UNIQUE constraint raises IntegrityError, not ValueError
CREATE TABLE without IF NOT EXISTS
clarifying_questions: duplicate pronunciation with a new priority

parts.lesson_anchor: FastSpeech 2 duration predictor; code/main.py duration and mel_schedule (integer frames, max(1, ...), round)
traps: remainders or total taken before the one-frame minimum
parts.integration: lexicon (Part 2) and frontend (Part 1) through the lesson's duration table at 1.25x speed

parts.lesson_anchor: The Problem: under 300 ms for a live voice assistant; first-chunk latency
parts.wire_format: server-sent events, one 'data: <json>' line per chunk and a blank line, decided by the test's split/startswith/json.loads
traps: deciding a mark at the end of a delta
only a space counts as whitespace
min_chars boundary (> instead of >=, the mark not counted, the leading space counted)
clarifying_questions: a mark followed by a quote
a long sentence with no punctuation

parts.lesson_anchor: The Problem: correct prosody (pauses, stress); the text frontend predicts prosody features; Use It: expressive and emotion tags
traps: tail text read with the child's prosody
inner prosody overrides instead of combining
namespace stripped from the root only
whitespace-only text as an empty segment
break without flushing the pending text

deviations: Part 1: the suggested abbreviation and punctuation-pause defects are one root cause here (the tokenizer splits the period off 'Dr.'); the number defect is the hyphen in number_words, which also gives the error three calls from its cause.

Part 4: min_chars applies only to , ; : so a short first sentence still goes out at once; numbers are protected by requiring whitespace after the mark and waiting for the next delta, not by a separate number rule.
Part 5: prosody carries rate and pitch only (volume dropped to fit 12 minutes); the W3C namespace is supported because real SSML documents carry it.
